event: 6-month import CLC below 1 in observed CBUAE window
interpretation: Cash/deposit-like reserve layer does not cover a 6-month implied import-liquidity floor in the observed CBUAE reserve-composition window.
Cash/deposit-like reserve layer loses majority status.

event: BIS global USD liabilities to UAE reach sample high
interpretation: Global banking dollar-liability layer to UAE reaches its highest observed value in the BIS sample.
Cash/deposit-like reserve layer no longer covers a 3-month implied import-liquidity floor.
Securities/foreign-investment reserve layer becomes larger than cash/deposit-like liquidity.

event: Latest BIS global USD liabilities to UAE
interpretation: Latest observed global BIS USD-liability layer remains large relative to official CBUAE reserves.
Cash/deposit-like reserve layer becomes thin relative to gross reserves.

event: Low-scenario UAE-BTAR exceeds 1 for BIS global USD liabilities to UAE
interpretation: Even the low encumbrance/leverage scenario is larger than observed Fed balance-sheet absorption for this bucket.
Cash/deposit-like reserve layer approaches hard liquidity minimum.
